_comment: Synthetic Slack-user roster for the localized-brief demo. Each entry is the SUBSET of a real users.info payload the resolvers read (id, tz, locale, profile.title, profile.fields). It lets vhaDailyBrief.js exercise the (position x location) parameterization in dry-run WITHOUT live Slack users. In production these come straight from users.info; this file is never used when a bot token is present unless VHA_BRIEF_USE_ROSTER=1. Chosen so several roles at the SAME facility (Phoenix) get DIFFERENT briefs, proving position filtering — and so location tiers vary (explicit binding vs tz inference vs tz-ambiguous).

users._expect: Phoenix (explicit binding) x Quality Manager -> SMR30 + OMELOS only
Phoenix (explicit binding) x Access Manager -> RVU_UNUSED only
Phoenix (explicit binding) x Patient Experience Officer -> SHEP_EXP only
Palo Alto (explicit binding; tz alone is ambiguous across CA/OR) x Care Transitions Lead -> READMIT30 only
Phoenix (director id) x ALL functions -> facility-wide brief (all 5 flagged metrics)
